settings.heading: Do you deliver across the UAE?

settings.text: Yes — we offer delivery across the UAE, with complimentary shipping on orders over AED 250 and delivery within 1-3 business days in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah.

settings.heading: What payment methods do you accept?

settings.text: We accept all major credit and debit cards, as well as cash on delivery for eligible UAE addresses. All checkout is encrypted and secure.

settings.heading: Can I return or exchange an item?

settings.text: Unopened, unused items may be returned within 14 days of delivery. Reach out to our support team and we'll take care of the rest.
